csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Indiana, Department of Transportation, may be seeking a consultant to provide Project Development Services 4 Intersection Improvement, Median U-turns along US 30 at King Rd, Queen Rd, SR 23 and SR 39 in LaPorte and Marshall County. The selected firm will perform the design and plan development work necessary to produce the construction contract documents. The selected firm will be required to provide all required Environmental Documentation, all Permits, Public Involvement-including public hearing and public information meetings, Topographic Survey, Road Design, Utility Coordination, Right of Way Plan Development (including Abstracting, R/W Engineering and R/W Staking), traffic management plans, and Construction Phase Services. Additional services may also be required, such as, Wetland Mitigation, Archaeological Investigations, Historical/Architectural Investigations, and Subsurface Utility Engineering. INDOT will perform the geotechnical services, pavement design, RW Buying and Real Estate Closing activities. The selected consultant's fee proposal shall be due 45 calendar days after the selection date for this RFP item.
